g.text: copies each input, swaps ONLY the queue-name fields
Each app parses its topic OUT OF THE FILE it mounts - deployed reads the fallback queue, A and B their own session queues.
The original ConfigMap is never modified. Session copies are owned by the PreviewSession and garbage-collected with it.
The config_mounts rewrite is content-based: any mount path works, and content without the split's names stays byte-identical.
